user.title: AGERE Water Price
user.description: Pick the water-meter sensor reporting cumulative consumption in m³. Billing periods come from meter readings, which you add afterwards under Configure.

readings.title: Readings
readings.description: Each reading is the END of a billing period — the 'Leitura' date on your invoice, not the invoice date — paired with the cumulative meter total. Pick one to edit or delete it.

reading_edit.title: Reading
reading_edit.description: Date of the meter reading (end of the billing period) and the meter total in m³, both as printed on the AGERE invoice. Use the invoice's 'Leitura' value — the cumulative meter total — and NOT the 'Consumo' value, which is only that period's usage.

next_reading.title: Next reading date
next_reading.description: When the current period closes — the 'Período de Comunicação' date on your invoice. Without it, the period length is estimated from the previous one.

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.description: AGERE changes its tariff on dates that differ per component and never on the calendar year. Each entry holds a complete set of values from its effective date onwards. Pick one to edit or delete it.

tariff_edit.title: Tariff
tariff_edit.description: Values as printed in the invoice's 'Valor Unit.' column. A new entry starts pre-filled from the most recent one, so only what changed needs typing. Leave the top water tier empty if you do not know its price — it is better than guessing.

data.water_tier_bounds: Tier bounds in m³, comma separated (e.g. 5,10,15,25)
data.water_tier_price_5: Water above 25 m³ (€/m³), empty if unknown

error.invalid_reading: {error}. Enter the cumulative meter total (the invoice's 'Leitura' value), not the period's consumption ('Consumo').
error.invalid_number: That meter value is not a valid number.

set_reading.name: Set meter reading
set_reading.description: Adds or replaces a meter reading. The date is the END of the billing period — the 'Leitura' date on the AGERE invoice, not the invoice date.

date.name: Reading date
date.description: End of the billing period, as printed on the invoice.

m3.name: Meter reading (m³)
m3.description: Meter value from the invoice. Leave empty to take it from the meter sensor's recorded history on that date.

config_entry.name: Integration entry
config_entry.description: Which AGERE entry to update. Only needed with more than one.

remove_reading.name: Remove meter reading
remove_reading.description: Deletes the reading with this date from the log.

date.name: Reading date
date.description: Date of the reading to delete.

config_entry.name: Integration entry
config_entry.description: Which AGERE entry to update. Only needed with more than one.

set_next_reading_date.name: Set next reading date
set_next_reading_date.description: Sets when the current billing period closes — the 'Período de Comunicação' date on the invoice. Leave the date empty to clear it and estimate from the previous period.

date.name: Next reading date
date.description: When the current period closes. Empty clears it.

config_entry.name: Integration entry
config_entry.description: Which AGERE entry to update. Only needed with more than one.
